item.title: PepsiCo promotes Amit Kumar Nanchahal as Brand Communications Head for International Beverages
item.description: New Delhi: PepsiCo has promoted Amit Kumar Nanchahal to the role of Brand Communications Head, International Beverages, overseeing Sting Energy and Mountain Dew. He shared the update in a LinkedIn post, stating that he is starting a new position within the organisation. item.description: New Delhi: India Today will air an exclusive interview with Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva tonight, with telecasts scheduled at 8 pm and 10 pm. item.title: Reebok appoints Olympic shooter Manu Bhaker as brand ambassador in India
item.description: New Delhi: Reebok has named Manu Bhaker as its brand ambassador in India.Bhaker, 24, is among India’s leading sport shooters. At the 2024 Summer Olympics in Paris, she won two bronze medals in the women’s 10m air pistol and the 10m air pistol mixed team events. With this, she became the first Indian athlete to secure two medals at a single Olympic Games and the first Indian woman shooter to win an Olympic medal. item.title: United Breweries secures trademark for Kingfisher’s iconic “Oo La La La Le O” jingle
item.description: New Delhi: United Breweries (UBL), part of the HEINEKEN Company, has been granted trademark registration for the Kingfisher Jingle “Oo La La La Le O”, formally recognising the sonic identity that has been a part of the brand for almost 30 years. With the registration, UBL becomes the first company in India’s alcoholic beverages sector to secure a registered sonic trademark.
